# Vendored browser libraries

These files are unmodified copies downloaded from jsDelivr. They are vendored
so the UI works without third-party CDN access from the browser.

| File | Package | Version | Source |
|------|---------|---------|--------|
| marked.min.js | marked | 15.0.12 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/marked@15/marked.min.js |
| purify.min.js | dompurify | 3.4.16 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/dompurify@3/dist/purify.min.js |
